About Us

## About Radiant Vista – Business Hotel in Hubballi

Radiant Vista is a business hotel on Gokul Road in Hubballi, Karnataka, close to Hubballi Airport, with three room types, the Brick and Brew restaurant, the Breeze Point rooftop bar and the Gala Vista banquet halls.

The hotel is designed for corporate travellers, families and anyone in the city for a celebration. It brings the efficiency of a business hotel together with the warmth of a place to relax.

You will find designer rooms, two places to eat and drink, the Brick and Brew restaurant and the Breeze Point rooftop bar, and the Gala Vista halls for banquets and conferences. The front desk is open around the clock.

### Premium Stay

Designer rooms with modern amenities.

### Dining & Events

### Brick and Brew

"Premium Nostalgia"

Brick and Brew is the hotel's in-house restaurant. It serves nostalgic Indian favourites with a bold, modern edge, for hotel guests and local food lovers alike.

Walk in and you’re hit with retro Bollywood beats, earthy vibes, and comforting food favourites served with a bold, modern twist. Born from a love for nostalgic flavours, Brick and Brew blends the cherished tastes of the past with the style and spirit of today’s India.

Think butter chicken that looks like a masterpiece, momos with a gourmet dimsum twist, and nani’s dal served with five-star plating elegance.

It is an easy choice for a family meal, a business lunch or dinner with colleagues, a short drive from Inorbit Mall.

Explore Hubballi

## Nearby Places & Attractions in Hubballi

The hotel's location on Gokul Road puts shopping, transport and the city's best-known sights within easy reach:

- ### Inorbit Mall Hubballi The city's main mall for shopping, dining and family entertainment, a short drive from the hotel.
- ### Hubballi Airport The domestic airport sits on the same Gokul Road corridor as the hotel, which makes airport transfers easy.
- ### Hubballi Junction The main railway station of the South Western Railway zone, with trains to Bengaluru, Mumbai, Goa and beyond.
- ### Unkal Lake A 110-year-old lake with parkland, boating and a large statue of Swami Vivekananda. Popular at sunset.
- ### Chandramouleshwara Temple An 11th-century Western Chalukya temple known for its detailed black stone carvings.
- ### Nrupatunga Betta A hilltop viewpoint with wide views over Hubballi-Dharwad, best visited at sunrise or sunset.
- ### Siddharoodha Math A historic spiritual centre and ashram dedicated to Sri Siddharoodha Swami, visited by devotees from across the region.
- ### Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden A public garden with a glass house modelled on London's Crystal Palace. It hosts the city's flower shows.

For opening times, tips and more places to visit, see our [Hubballi guide](https://hotelradiantvista.com/hubballi-guide/).

Getting Here

## Location & Accessibility – Gokul Road, Hubballi

**Radiant Vista**, Plot No 04, S/No 106A, 107B, 108A & 109A, Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi, Karnataka 580030, India
Phone: [+91 836 200 2487](tel:+918362002487)
Email: [reservations@hotelradiantvista.com](mailto:reservations@hotelradiantvista.com)

The hotel is in Akshay Park on Gokul Road, the main road to Hubballi Airport. Here is how to reach us:

- **From Hubballi Airport**. Leave the airport on Gokul Road. Radiant Vista is on the same road in Akshay Park, so there is no need to cross the city centre.
- **From Hubballi Junction railway station**. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw towards Gokul Road and ask for Akshay Park. Share your train time with reservations if you would like help with transport.
- **From the Hubballi new bus stand**. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw along Gokul Road to Akshay Park; the hotel is on the main road.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Frequently Asked Questions About Radiant Vista Hubballi

### Where is Radiant Vista located?

Radiant Vista is at Plot No 04, S/No 106A, 107B, 108A & 109A, Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi, Karnataka 580030. The hotel is on Gokul Road, the same corridor as Hubballi Airport, and close to Inorbit Mall. Hubballi Junction railway station and the city centre are an easy drive away.

### Is Hubballi the same city as Hubli?

Yes. Hubballi is the official Kannada name and Hubli is the older English spelling of the same city in northern Karnataka. Together with Dharwad it forms the twin city of Hubballi-Dharwad, the second-largest urban area in the state after Bengaluru.

### Does Radiant Vista have a restaurant?

Yes. Brick and Brew is the hotel's restaurant. It serves nostalgic Indian favourites with a modern twist, such as butter chicken, momos with a dim sum touch and home-style dal, in a lively setting with retro Bollywood music. Hotel guests and visitors are both welcome.

### Is there a rooftop bar at Radiant Vista?

Yes. Breeze Point is the hotel's open-roof rooftop bar and restaurant. It serves curated cocktails and savoury dishes with views over Hubballi. Separate areas make it suitable for a quiet dinner for two or a night out with friends. Enquire on WhatsApp to reserve a table.

### Can I book a banquet hall for a wedding or a corporate event?

Yes. Gala Vista has two halls. Gala Vista I is a grand banquet hall for weddings and receptions. Gala Vista II is a conference and event space for seminars and meetings. Call +91 836 200 2487 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com to check dates and packages.

### What room types does Radiant Vista offer?

There are three room types: the Classic Room, the Premium Room and the Suite. Every room has individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV and high-speed Wi-Fi. Premium Rooms and Suites add a mini fridge and a safe deposit locker, and the Suite has a separate lounge.

### Is Radiant Vista a good choice for business travellers?

Yes. It is a business hotel close to the airport, with a business center, work desks in every room, high-speed Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. Gala Vista II hosts meetings and training sessions, and the travel desk can help with local transport.

### How do I book a room or reserve a table?

Book a room online through our booking engine, or call reservations on +91 91871 95517. You can also WhatsApp the same number, call the front desk on +91 836 200 2487 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com. For Brick and Brew or Breeze Point, a WhatsApp message is the quickest way to reserve.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Rooms & Accommodation FAQ

### What room types are available at Radiant Vista?

Radiant Vista has three room types: the Classic Room, the Premium Room and the Suite. All rooms have individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV and high-speed Wi-Fi. The Suite adds a separate lounge, which is useful for families and guests who need to meet in private.

### What amenities are included in every room?

Every room has individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV, a hot water kettle, high-speed Wi-Fi and a work desk, and the whole building is CCTV-secured. Premium Rooms and Suites also include a mini fridge and a safe deposit locker for your valuables.

### What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in and check-out times are confirmed with your booking. If you are arriving early or leaving late, tell the reservations team when you book. Call or WhatsApp +91 91871 95517 and they will confirm what is possible for your dates.

### What ID do I need at check-in?

Please bring a valid government-issued photo ID for every adult guest, such as an Aadhaar card, passport, driving licence or voter ID. Foreign nationals need a passport and visa. If you are unsure whether a document will be accepted, ask reservations on +91 91871 95517 before you travel.

### Is parking available at the hotel?

Yes. Radiant Vista has secure basement parking for guests, and the premises are monitored by CCTV around the clock. If you are coming with several cars for an event or a group booking, let the front desk know in advance so the team can plan parking for you.

### Can I get a GST invoice for a corporate stay?

If you need a GST invoice for a business stay, tell the reservations team when you book and share your company name, billing address and GSTIN. Call or WhatsApp +91 91871 95517, or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com, so the details are on file before you check in.

### How do I book a room at Radiant Vista?

The quickest way is our online booking engine, which shows live availability and rates. You can also call or WhatsApp reservations on +91 91871 95517, call the front desk on +91 836 200 2487, or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com. The team can help with group, corporate and long-stay bookings.

# Brick and Brew — Vibrant Dining Restaurant in Hubballi

Brick and Brew is the restaurant at Radiant Vista in Hubballi (Hubli), serving nostalgic Indian favourites with a bold, modern edge to hotel guests and visitors.

Restaurant in Hubballi

## Premium Nostalgia with a Modern Twist

Ever craved butter chicken that looks like a masterpiece? Or momo with a dimsum twist? Welcome to Brick and Brew—where every dish is a throwback to your favourite food memories, but with a bold, modern edge.

Walk in and you’re hit with retro Bollywood beats, earthy vibes, pomegranate motifs (that’s our OG inspo!), and maybe even a flaming cocktail. Born from a love for comforting food and the cultural quirks we all grew up with, Brick and Brew blends the flavours of the past with the style and spirit of today’s India.

Think your nani’s dal but with five-star plating twist. This is not just another restaurant; it's a feeling like no other. 'It’s India but cooler, sassier, and way more Instagrammable.'

Frequently Asked Questions

## Brick and Brew FAQ

### What kind of food does Brick and Brew serve?

Brick and Brew serves Indian comfort food with a modern twist. Think butter chicken plated like a work of art, momos with a gourmet dim sum touch and home-style dal finished with five-star presentation. The mood is set by retro Bollywood music, earthy decor and pomegranate motifs.

### Can visitors who are not staying at the hotel eat at Brick and Brew?

Yes. Brick and Brew welcomes both hotel guests and visitors from around Hubballi. It works well for a family meal, a business lunch or dinner with friends. For larger groups, send a WhatsApp message in advance so the team can arrange a table that seats everyone together.

### How do I reserve a table at Brick and Brew?

Send a WhatsApp message to +91 91871 95517 with your date, time and number of guests, and the team will confirm your table. You can also call the front desk on +91 836 200 2487. Reserving ahead is a good idea for weekends and for groups.

### What are Brick and Brew's opening hours?

Opening hours can change on holidays and for private events, so please check before you visit. Call +91 836 200 2487 or send a WhatsApp message to +91 91871 95517 and the team will confirm today's timings, along with any set menus or special evenings.

### Is Brick and Brew suitable for group dinners?

Yes. The restaurant has long tables for family get-togethers and group dinners, as well as cosy booths for smaller parties. For birthdays, office dinners or larger gatherings, contact the team in advance. Gala Vista banquet halls are also available in the same hotel for bigger events.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Breeze Point FAQ

### What is Breeze Point?

Breeze Point is the rooftop bar and restaurant at Radiant Vista in Hubballi. It has an open-roof terrace with views over the city, curated cocktails made by our bar team and a rotating menu of savoury bites and meals. It suits both a quiet date and a night out with friends.

### Does Breeze Point serve alcohol?

Yes. Breeze Point is a bar as well as a restaurant, and our barman creates classic curated cocktails alongside a selection of spirits. In Karnataka the legal drinking age is 21, so please carry a photo ID. Ask the bar team for a drink to suit the dishes you order.

### What are Breeze Point's timings?

Breeze Point is an evening venue, and timings can change for events and holidays. Call +91 836 200 2487 or send a WhatsApp message to +91 91871 95517 to confirm today's hours and reserve a table, especially on weekends when the rooftop fills up quickly.

### Can I host a private party at Breeze Point?

Yes. The rooftop has separate spaces, so it works well for birthdays, team evenings and small celebrations. Share your date, group size and food and drink preferences on WhatsApp at +91 91871 95517. For larger events, the Gala Vista banquet halls are in the same building.

### Is food served at Breeze Point?

Yes. Alongside the bar, Breeze Point serves savoury bites and a rotating selection of meals, so you can make a full dinner of it. If you want a sit-down dinner with a wider menu, Brick and Brew restaurant is in the same hotel.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Gala Vista Banquets FAQ

### What banquet halls does Gala Vista have?

Gala Vista has two halls inside Radiant Vista. Gala Vista I is a grand banquet hall for weddings, receptions and family celebrations. Gala Vista II is a conference and event space for seminars, training sessions and corporate meetings. Both are supported by the hotel's catering and events team.

### How many guests can the Gala Vista halls hold?

Capacity depends on the hall and the layout you choose, such as theatre seating, round tables or a floating crowd. Share your expected guest count and event type on WhatsApp at +91 91871 95517 and the events team will suggest the right hall and setup for you.

### What do banquet packages cost per plate?

Packages and per-plate prices depend on the menu, guest count, hall, date and any decor or equipment you need. Share these details on WhatsApp at +91 91871 95517 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com, and the events team will send a detailed quote for your event.

### Is catering available for events?

Yes. Gala Vista events are supported by on-site catering and banquet management, so food, service and coordination come from one team. Share your preferred cuisine and menu style when you enquire, and the team will suggest options that suit your guests and budget.

### Is there parking and Wi-Fi for events?

Yes. Guests can use the hotel's secure basement parking, and Gala Vista II has high-speed Wi-Fi and presentation connectivity for conferences. If you expect many cars or need specific equipment, tell the events team when you book so everything is ready on the day.

### How do I enquire about a date?

Use the event planner on this page to choose your event type and date, then send it straight to WhatsApp. You can also message +91 91871 95517, call +91 836 200 2487 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com. The team will confirm availability and send package details.

About Us

# About Radiant Vista

Radiant Vista is a business hotel on Gokul Road in Hubballi, Karnataka, close to Hubballi Airport, with three room types, the Brick and Brew restaurant, the Breeze Point rooftop bar and the Gala Vista banquet halls.

## A hotel for work and for leisure

Radiant Vista brings business and leisure together under one roof. Guests come to Hubballi for meetings, conferences and family occasions, and the hotel is set up for all three.

The rooms are designed for rest and for work, with work desks and fast Wi-Fi. In the hotel, Brick and Brew serves nostalgic Indian favourites, and on the roof, Breeze Point is the place to unwind in the evening. For bigger occasions, the two Gala Vista halls host weddings, receptions and corporate events.

## What you will find at the hotel

- **Rooms:** [Classic Room](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/#classic), [Premium Room](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/#premium), [Suite](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/#suite), all with individually controlled AC, a 42-inch Smart TV and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- **Dining:** [Brick and Brew](https://hotelradiantvista.com/dining/), the in-house restaurant for Indian comfort food with a modern twist.
- **Rooftop bar:** [Breeze Point](https://hotelradiantvista.com/bar/), an open-roof bar and restaurant with views over the city.
- **Events:** [Gala Vista I](https://hotelradiantvista.com/banquets/weddings/) for weddings and receptions, and [Gala Vista II](https://hotelradiantvista.com/banquets/conferences/) for conferences and meetings.
- **Services:** a business center, a travel desk, secure basement parking, CCTV across the premises and a 24-hour front desk.

## What is nearby

The hotel is in Akshay Park on Gokul Road, the road that also leads to Hubballi Airport. Inorbit Mall is close by, and the railway station and the city's temples, lakes and gardens are an easy drive away.

- **Inorbit Mall Hubballi:** The city's main mall for shopping, dining and family entertainment, a short drive from the hotel.
- **Hubballi Airport:** The domestic airport sits on the same Gokul Road corridor as the hotel, which makes airport transfers easy.
- **Hubballi Junction:** The main railway station of the South Western Railway zone, with trains to Bengaluru, Mumbai, Goa and beyond.
- **Unkal Lake:** A 110-year-old lake with parkland, boating and a large statue of Swami Vivekananda. Popular at sunset.
- **Chandramouleshwara Temple:** An 11th-century Western Chalukya temple known for its detailed black stone carvings.

See the [Hubballi guide](https://hotelradiantvista.com/hubballi-guide/) for more places to visit, or [contact us](https://hotelradiantvista.com/contact/) for directions.

## Explore More at Radiant Vista

# Hotel Near Hubballi Airport

Radiant Vista is a business hotel on Gokul Road, the same road as Hubballi Airport, which makes it an easy base for short trips and early flights.

## Getting here from the airport

Hubballi Airport and Radiant Vista are both on Gokul Road. Leave the airport on Gokul Road and head towards Akshay Park. You do not need to cross the city centre, which helps at peak hours.

- **From Hubballi Airport**. Leave the airport on Gokul Road. Radiant Vista is on the same road in Akshay Park, so there is no need to cross the city centre.
- **From Hubballi Junction railway station**. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw towards Gokul Road and ask for Akshay Park. Share your train time with reservations if you would like help with transport.
- **From the Hubballi new bus stand**. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw along Gokul Road to Akshay Park; the hotel is on the main road.

## Airport transfers

The hotel's travel desk helps guests with transport around Hubballi. Send your flight number and arrival time to reservations on +91 91871 95517, ideally a day before you travel, and the team will tell you what pickup options are available.

## Rooms for short stays

All three room types work well for a one-night stop: [Classic Room](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/#classic), [Premium Room](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/#premium), [Suite](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/#suite). Every room has a work desk, high-speed Wi-Fi and individually controlled air conditioning, so you can catch up on work or rest before a flight.

Brick and Brew restaurant and the Breeze Point rooftop bar are in the same building, so a good meal is never far away after a long journey.

### How far is Radiant Vista from Hubballi Airport?

Radiant Vista and Hubballi Airport are both on Gokul Road, so the drive is simple and avoids the city centre. Allow extra time at peak hours. Share your flight details with reservations on +91 91871 95517 and the team will advise on the quickest way to reach the hotel.

The hotel's travel desk helps guests with transport around the city. Send your flight number and arrival time to reservations on +91 91871 95517 at least a day before you travel, and the team will tell you what pickup options are available and what they cost.

### Can I check in early after a morning flight?

# Corporate Stays at Radiant Vista

Radiant Vista is a business hotel on Gokul Road in Hubballi with work-ready rooms, a business center and the Gala Vista II meeting hall, close to the airport.

## Rooms you can work in

Every room has a work desk, high-speed Wi-Fi and individually controlled air conditioning. The Premium Room adds an executive work desk, a safe deposit locker and a mini fridge. The Suite has a separate lounge for small meetings.

[Compare the rooms](https://hotelradiantvista.com/rooms/)

## Meetings, training and conferences

[Gala Vista II](https://hotelradiantvista.com/banquets/conferences/) is a conference and event space for seminars, training sessions, presentations and board meetings. It has high-speed Wi-Fi and presentation connectivity, with on-site catering for tea breaks and working lunches.

The business center is available for work between meetings, and the front desk is open 24 hours.

## Billing, GST and long stays

For company bookings, share your company name, billing address and GSTIN with reservations when you book, so invoices are prepared correctly. Ask about corporate and long-stay rates by emailing reservations@hotelradiantvista.com or calling +91 91871 95517.

## Getting around

The hotel is on Gokul Road, close to [Hubballi Airport](https://hotelradiantvista.com/hotel-near-hubballi-airport/). The travel desk can help with local transport for your team, and secure basement parking is available for guests who drive.

### Does Radiant Vista offer corporate rates?

Companies that send guests regularly can ask about corporate and long-stay rates. Email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com or call reservations on +91 91871 95517 with your company name, the number of room nights you expect and your usual travel dates, and the team will get back to you.

### Can I get a GST invoice for a corporate stay?

If you need a GST invoice for a business stay, tell the reservations team when you book and share your company name, billing address and GSTIN. Call or WhatsApp +91 91871 95517, or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com, so the details are on file before you check in.

### Are there meeting rooms at the hotel?

Yes. Gala Vista II is a conference and event space for seminars, training sessions, presentations and board meetings, with high-speed Wi-Fi and presentation connectivity. The hotel also has a business center for work between meetings, and on-site catering is available for working lunches and tea breaks.

# Hubballi Travel Guide: Places to Visit Near Radiant Vista

URL: https://hotelradiantvista.com/hubballi-guide/
Last updated: 2026-11-20

[Home](https://hotelradiantvista.com/) / Hubballi Guide

Explore the city

# Hubballi Guide: Places to Visit Near Radiant Vista

Hubballi, also written Hubli, is a commercial city in northern Karnataka, and Radiant Vista on Gokul Road is a convenient base for its lakes, temples, gardens and shopping.

## Places to visit

### Inorbit Mall Hubballi

The city's main mall for shopping, dining and family entertainment, a short drive from the hotel.

### Unkal Lake

A 110-year-old lake with parkland, boating and a large statue of Swami Vivekananda. Popular at sunset.

### Chandramouleshwara Temple

An 11th-century Western Chalukya temple known for its detailed black stone carvings.

### Nrupatunga Betta

A hilltop viewpoint with wide views over Hubballi-Dharwad, best visited at sunrise or sunset.

### Siddharoodha Math

A historic spiritual centre and ashram dedicated to Sri Siddharoodha Swami, visited by devotees from across the region.

### Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden

A public garden with a glass house modelled on London's Crystal Palace. It hosts the city's flower shows.

## Distances from the hotel

| Place |
|---|
| Inorbit Mall Hubballi |
| Hubballi Airport |
| Hubballi Junction |
| Unkal Lake |
| Chandramouleshwara Temple |
| Nrupatunga Betta |
| Siddharoodha Math |
| Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden |

The travel desk can help you plan a half-day or full-day tour of the city and arrange local transport.

## Getting around Hubballi

Taxis and auto-rickshaws are the easiest way to get around. The hotel is on Gokul Road, near the airport, and Hubballi Junction railway station connects the city to Bengaluru, Mumbai, Goa and beyond.

- **From Hubballi Airport**. Leave the airport on Gokul Road. Radiant Vista is on the same road in Akshay Park, so there is no need to cross the city centre.
- **From Hubballi Junction railway station**. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw towards Gokul Road and ask for Akshay Park. Share your train time with reservations if you would like help with transport.
- **From the Hubballi new bus stand**. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw along Gokul Road to Akshay Park; the hotel is on the main road.
